rv.q: And there was, of course, Jean Armour, his wife, mother to his nine children – three of whom survived – and, as per one of his most famous poems, the lassie he loved best.
It’s rare, though, to encounter one that blazes with such a special energy as Nikolai Foster’s 2021. Leicester Curve production of A Chorus Line , playing at the Festival Theatre this week.
Armour is an enlightening play which, to its core, asks the audience: “ Next time you toast the Bard, think of the women too”.
